# qorvex

Reverse engineer anything from your terminal or agent.

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `qorvex inspect-byte-entropy <path>` | Inspect file-wide and block byte entropy without executing the file |

Run `qorvex --llms-full` for full manifest. Run `qorvex <command> --schema` for argument details.
